verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a local HTTP APIs server explicitly built for external programmatic read/write access to the graph, plus a plugin API for third-party tools — a plausible headless read/write path for an agent. However, a first-hand community report on the newer DB-based version states plainly that they can 'no longer use Claude or codex to write or update pages,' a concrete regression contradicting the documented external-access capability, and no MCP server or OpenAPI spec is exposed (probe confirms 404s for both), so integration is thin and unstable. missing for 10: a documented MCP server, a stable/versioned OpenAPI spec, and confirmation the HTTP API still supports write in the current DB version.
